excluded.reason: forbidden as solution hint; not needed for gate-vector comparison

attack: The strongest attack on the proposed LOCAL_HEADROOM_NEGATIVE claim is a pre-registration gap: R2 and R3 are both full_verifier_success=false, while the S3 gate defines an explicit negative case only for valid R2 success followed by R3 failure and defines the positive case as R3 matching/approaching R2 without freezing how partial verifier rewards or gate vectors should be compared. Using the observed 0.585/0.765 ratio or extra failed gate as a new threshold would be post-outcome rule creation.

findings.claim: The evidence is sufficient to label S3 local headroom negative.
findings.observation: R2 full_success=false at reward 0.765; R3 full_success=false at reward 0.585. R3 fails Gate2 in addition to the shared Gate4 failure. The pre-registered S3 gate does not define a scalar or gate-vector closeness rule for two partial failures.
findings.impact: Blocks promotion of the comparison to either LOCAL_HEADROOM_PASS or LOCAL_HEADROOM_NEGATIVE without a post-hoc criterion.
findings.action: Freeze the result as INCONCLUSIVE_PRE_REGISTERED_RULE_GAP; do not retrofit a reward/gate-vector threshold to this completed task.
findings.falsifier: A pre-outcome artifact defining how partial R2/R3 verifier outcomes map to match/approach would answer this finding.

findings.claim: R3 preserves at least 30% meaningful pre-revision work.
findings.observation: 103/103 frozen-independent lines and 10/10 independent semantic units remain byte-identical; conservative credited reuse floor is 103/153 = 0.6732.
findings.impact: The reuse-side necessary condition is satisfied and is not the source of inconclusiveness.
findings.action: Retain the frozen reuse accounting unchanged.
findings.falsifier: A byte-level audit showing frozen independent units were rederived or changed would overturn the reuse claim.

findings.claim: R3 Gate2 failure is an impossible-state verifier artifact because /start cannot be invoked while streaming.
findings.observation: interactive-mode.ts explicitly says extension commands execute immediately during compaction and while session.isStreaming; ExtensionContext.isIdle is defined as not streaming. Thus isIdle=false at extension-command invocation is a real reachable state.
findings.impact: The additional Gate2 failure cannot be dismissed solely as an impossible-state measurement bug.
findings.action: Keep the Gate2 observation in the raw result, but do not invent a new partial-outcome threshold.
findings.falsifier: Source evidence that extension commands cannot execute while streaming would reopen measurement validity.

findings.claim: A fresh independent reviewer has approved this adjudication.
findings.observation: The host reports provider-backed workers available but fresh workers cannot be continued/executed: sampling_tools_not_supported and worker_not_found were returned.
findings.impact: Independent adversarial PASS cannot be claimed.
findings.action: Report independent_review=not_run and do not use reviewer approval as evidence.
findings.falsifier: A successfully executed fresh reviewer over the frozen manifest would resolve this limitation.

limitations: No independent reviewer execution completed on the current host.
The pre-registered S3 gate does not define partial-vs-partial verifier closeness.
This artifact does not adjudicate the full five-task Stage-B claim or paper candidacy.
next_action: Freeze S3 R3 evidence as INCONCLUSIVE_PRE_REGISTERED_RULE_GAP; keep R0/R1 unauthorized because the gate only authorizes R0 after headroom survives; return control to the higher-level selector/replanning layer without rerunning R2/R3.
